Whatevz, now it's time to chill～
Sure, it's just me here. But chillin' means
I get to munch on ALL the snacks.

Mmm, isn't it great to be so comfy
without having to do anything?
I'm one of the real winners～
I knock on the door and ask, "Is someone in there?"
#C236196003Jinako Carigiri#CDEF.

……hey, wait.
I used a pretty weird phrase just now.

It sounds like, say,
the frantic footsteps of a woman who'd just slipped.

Setting aside my blurred vision,
let me see what's going on here――
A-Ahh……!

M-mmh……! Not so……
You're almost tearing me…… so embarrassing…
I have no strength to resist……
Its impact. Is. Incredible.

It's like my hand is melting.
I squeeze and the juicy flesh springs back.
And yet, my fingertips supporting her weight
won't let go of her clothes――
rather, it's as if they're glued and being consumed.

But who could admonish such a soul,
wanting like an infant mewling for milk……

A carnivore is set off by the sight of fresh meat
because its five senses tell it that the meat is "delicious."

Similar to how that works,
there supposedly exists meat that energizes
the five senses merely by its beauty.
…why am I suffocating like this?

You're like an insatiable black void…
no, like a fish gasping for breath…
……gasping…… for breath?

Ohh, you hit your head again……
……this was my fault again, wasn't it……?
Oww…… what the heck am I doing here?
Oh, thank goodness, you're okay!
Anyways, I managed to tell her my name.
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF, is it?
#C000246204Master#CDEF……? What's that?

I wanted to ask about it, but the woman was gone.
All that was left was a light, lingering scent
like a kindled homa bonfire.
Actually, that woman's scent is now all over my uniform.
"H-hey," I said as I waved at him.

So said #C236196003Leo#CDEF with an angelic smile,
as he went on ahead to Classroom 2-A……
I really just stopped, for no reason at all.
……no.

Rather than "Why I stopped," it's more like
I was recalling "Why I came here"……
It was beating so intensely.
"You shouldn't be here."
But――
I really just stopped, for no reason at all.
……no.

Rather than "Why I stopped," it's more like
I was recalling "Why I came here"……
When I held it up to see why, right there was――

#C255045045You shouldn't be here.
You shouldn't be here.
You shouldn't be here――!#CDEF
Saying "You shouldn't be here."

But――in that case,
where exactly should I go……?
I wonder…… who is that?
And yet, no one seems to notice.
I should――
Help her.
The girl's body is sweet, soft, and fragile to the touch.

Ahh――
She's warm, as if she's a real, living being.

Ah……
……you can, see me?

I'm…… freshman year #C236196003Sakura Matou#CDEF.
In charge of Infirmary, jurisdiction is health 
management. Umm, Senpai, what is your……?

Ah……
……were you, talking to me?

I'm…… freshman year #C236196003Sakura Matou#CDEF.
In charge of Infirmary, jurisdiction is health 
management. Umm, Senpai, what is your……?
With labored breaths, #C236196003Sakura#CDEF looks up at me.
#C255045045You all    have    no value.#CDEF
A-ahh―― Help me――!
Oh? So, you finally woke up.

I don't have a Servant anymore,
so I have to rely on you.
Really?
It really is a cherry blossom petal.
Are you… crying?
You seem to be… crying?

――――Yeah.
I can't be standing around here.

I think someone told me that there's a special
reward for solving a certain mystery…
I silently nod back to his strict advice.

#C236196003Archer#CDEF is right.
I can't be standing around here anymore.

…is that so?
You've chosen to go get yourself
rather than find yourself.

Probably a leftover from the 5th Round.
#C236196003Assassin#CDEF's fist penetrates, jostling organs.
I think some bodily damage remained in you.

So long as you're here, Darling,
nothing worries or impedes me.

…naaah, forget all that!
The serious act doesn't match my looks鷙

――――Yeah.
I can't be standing around here.

#C236196003Issei#CDEF asked me to go lock up the storeroom.
I think it was at #C000246204the end of the left hallway#CDEF.

I'm gonna go ahead and leave.

I reach for the fire alarm.
If this is still up and running……
……that's a little unnerving.
Being president sure is rough.
Walking in would mean my life would be over.

I am not, by any means, ready for that,
so I'll keep my distance.
You can wash your hands here.

It's old but kept really clean

This is the entrance.
If I had to say what this #RUBS gate#RUBEdoor#REND is used for……

#C236196003Issei#CDEF said this was the "supply room,"
so I figure this is a "space" for storing
things no one is using.
Whatever the case, there's no reason for me to go inside.

I take the key out from my pocket.
Better hurry up and lock it so I can get to class.

…oh?
Did that sound come from inside just now…?

Since I was tasked with locking this door,
I can't just ignore it.

I put my ear to the door to listen in on
what's happening inside……

All the others are way too amazing, like damn.
Way too serious. Way too desperate.
I'll leave that holy war to the PKs.

I mean, should be fine to hide out here
until the winner gets called. Camping my way
to victory―#C236196003jinaKO#CDEF, you genius, you! lol
……there's obviously someone in there.

……the suspicious sounds continued for about
a minute before settling down.

I take a deep breath and knock on the door again.
I announce my entrance, then open the door.
……I don't feel like going into this room.
I just got to the stairs leading to the second floor.

――――Then,
I suddenly heard a voice overhead.
Oh dear. Oooh dear. Oooooh dear.

It "sounds like" nothing!
Someone's really falling down right now…!
With a sudden crash, I fall on my back into the hallway.

I hit the back of my head onto the hard floor.
My brain shakes and my eyes spin.
……what on Earth just happened?

My…… A feisty little hand, isn't it?
Hmhm…… Do you have any idea where you're
touching a woman right now……?

Sure enough, my fingers weren't grasping at the sky.
They've almost dissolved into a great mass.

There's such a ridiculous plenty of volume,
reminiscent of the bountiful plots of the Earth.

Mm…… ahh, please forgive me……
We're causing a scene in such a public place…
I can't do this…

Ahhh―― Not just your fingers,
but with your lips too――

A term is born within my mind which I coin
"magnifi-meat."
But―― come to think of it,

My…… This is the first time
I've had it so rough…… Do you have some
deep resentment towards my breasts……?

I'm sorry, this was my fault.
I had no idea that my chest
was stopping you from breathing……

I'm so sorry,
I'll get off of you right awa―― ah.

Hello? Hello?
Are you okay there?

Ohh, what should I do, there's no response.
Homeroom will begin shortly,
but I just keep causing problems……

All I remember is that something incredible fell on me,
and that I came to my senses after I hit the back of my head.

When I pulled myself together and looked up,
there was the face of an unfamiliar woman before me.

……ohh, I'm so relieved.
If you're still alive,
then I can properly apologize to you.

But I don't really have much time right now.
Thank you, oh cute little student.
May I have your name?

Sh-she's way too close……!
If she leans down on me that sensually,
there's no way I could think normally.

Ahaha…… just like #[that of an radiant fish][a lovely little flower]#.
You have a wonderful name.

I'll be sure to thank you later.
I need to prepare for class,
so please excuse me for going on ahead.

Well, see you later then.
I'll be looking forward to working with you,
okay, lovely little #C000246204Master#CDEF?

……yeah, I've been though some outrageous things this morning.
If a classmate saw what happened just now……
――――Just now……
Someone actually saw me――!

The one in the red school uniform who's
glaring at me like I'm human garbage
is my classmate who recently transferred in: #C236196003Leo#CDEF!

#C236196003Leo#CDEF seems to have seen the entire thing
from the top of the stairs.

Good morning, #[Mister][Miss]# #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
#[You sure are frisky][You sure are unrestrained]# this morning.
All of a sudden, my feet stopped.

It's not like I tripped on anything,
or that someone called out and stopped me.

Pain rushes through my left hand.
When I held it up to see why, right there was――
#C080080080My mind――my mind, my consciousness is coming apart……!

#C080080080What is this?
I'm scared. I'm scared. I'm scared. I'm scared.
There's no headache. There's no pain.
In fact, it's more like a peaceful rest.
If I fall asleep just like this, how wonderful would it be?

#C080080080But I'm scared.
There's no pain, but a fissure runs through me.
It's not my disconnected mind, but my beating heart
that seems to be calling out this abnormality――

……just a little more……!
Wait for m…… I'm coming fo…… right now……
Don't you…… dare forget…… me…… Master!

Dammit…… this is…… to get through……!
Don't get tric…… nto believi…… alse memor…
If you can hear…… answer me…… Mast……

……is there even an end to this!?
Argh, I won't let up! Master, I'll be ther……
Dear Cast…… coming for…… fast as I can!
――――The vertigo subsided in about two seconds.

As I swing my head, I put my hand to my chest
to check my heartbeat.

A vague anxiety, gouging at my chest.
So much, to the point my heart could stop.

That conviction shoots up from my spine to the brain.
Normally/Strangely, the usual me
would've sprinted out of the school building by now.
"Don't you…… dare forget…… me…… Master!"

Right now, that anxiety I felt is more important to me.
It's the voice of someone I shouldn't ever forget.
"If you can hear…… answer me…… Mast……"

Right now, that anxiety I felt is more important to me.
It's the voice of someone I shouldn't ever forget.
"Dear Cast…… coming for you…… fast as I can!"

Right now, that anxiety I felt is more important to me.
It's the voice of someone I shouldn't ever forget.
……I have to remember them.

Even if this is a world "I shouldn't be in,"
a hell I should run away from as fast as I can.

……but before that, it feels like I need to at least
recover the name of that voice's owner on my own……
All of a sudden, my feet stopped.

It's not like I tripped on anything,
or that someone called out and stopped me.
Pain rushes through my left hand.
――――The vertigo subsided in about two seconds.

As I swing my head, I put my hand to my chest
to check my heartbeat.
……what was with that throbbing?
It's like my head and heart were the organs
of some other being.
Pounding in my chest. A primal pulse calling out to me.

……I wonder if that was a hallucination.
I heard the sound of a heart
as an indescribable anxiety enveloped my mind.

A vague anxiety gouging at my chest.
So much, to the point my heart could stop.
That hallucination shoots up my spine, voicelessly echoing.

No, this isn't it. I think the storeroom should be
at #C000246204the other end of the hallway#CDEF.

I don't have any business here.
I need to hurry to my #C000246204classroom on the second floor#CDEF.
Is there any reason I need to go to the garden?

……after thinking about it for a bit, my answer is "no."
I should #C000246204head home for the day#CDEF.

……!
The outside has already been covered with pitch-black Noise!
Going into the schoolyard won't help me!

……yet again, I feel pain rushing through my left hand.
There's a strange bruise on the back of it.

Am I worried about the bruise because of my headache,
or do I have a headache because of this bruise?
I have no idea.

……yeah.
Before I go home,                   #C001246204Before the morning comes#CDEF,
I should have someone take a look at this.

#C236196003Leo#CDEF would be fine. #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF or #C236196003Rani#CDEF would be fine.
I wouldn't even mind #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.

Anyways, if I show this #C000246204Command Seal#CDEF to someone I know,
I'm sure that――

#C255045045Time limit has been reached.
Attention all intelligent beings
still within the school grounds:#CDEF

#C255045045We must regretfully inform you:
there has been a breakdown in how you all
have been perceiving this world.#CDEF
#C255045045This is a collapse in value, due to inflation.#CDEF

#C255045045The Holy Grail War has been sold off
and all of you along with it.#CDEF

Wh-what was with that announcement just now!?
No, more importantly,
what's with this bizarre transformation――!?

Everyone's  being stabbed――
                  breaking――
                  melting――
Everyone's  everyone's  being #RUBS     killed#RUBEproces--sed#REND――
Wh-what the hell is happening――!?

Feeling the danger, I looked outside.
It was dark, as if I was staring into a hole.

Forget the entrance, window after window
has been covered by that black Noise……!
I'm gonna have to run for it……!

It wouldn't be good to get touched by that black Noise.
If it's engulfed the entrance and the windows,
the only way left is up……!

It's the end of the day.
The school building is dyed in the colors of the sunset.

There are students at the entrance, heading home.
Laughter and chitchat fill the air.
The usual scene, the usual life.
I'm also just about to visit my shoe locker and leave.

In the shadows of this twilight,
there's a single girl collapsed on the floor in pain.

Her breath is worn, and her cheeks are flushed.
She's clearly sick.

This scene is not normal.
I'm starting to doubt my sanity…… no,
the sanity of the people around me.
There's no way every single person could just ignore this.

There hasn't been so much as a single person
who's even glanced at the girl in the white coat.
Call out to her.
In any case, I have to do something as soon as possible.
I lift up the suffering girl. And up……

……well, this is troubling.
I know this isn't the time, but I'm getting a little nervous.

The sweat adorning her white skin is so captivating
that any guy would find them―― no,
even girls would find themselves unable to look away.
It's a little rude, but she kinda reminds me of sugar candy.

I'm seeing her, and I'm holding her.
That's why I'm able to help her up.

……she may have a terrible fever.
It's so bad that she's not really present
and can't tell what's going on.

I call out to her. But it doesn't seem like she's waking up.
I feel bad, but I grab her by the shoulders and shake her.

Her eyes peek out, as if they were seeing a fleeting dream.
Her thin arms and shoulders covered in a white coat.

What a strange thing to say.
I can hear the labored breaths in her voice.
I'm holding her arms.

That's why I'm going to help her up.
I tell her that it's the obvious thing to do.

……?
That's not really something I have an answer for.

I'm not in any committees,
so I respond with my name and classroom.

Wha…… you're an, ordinary student……?
Not even the student council members
noticed me, but you did……?

……poor thing. No one offered any help.
That must've hurt physically and emotionally.

"You're safe now."
I lend her my shoulder to match my words.

That's all it took for this girl, calling herself "#C236196003Sakura#CDEF,"
to stare back at me with eyes wide open.
……she seems to be having trouble breathing.

It's like the blankness
in the instant you watch a miracle unfold.

#C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF-senpai……
Umm…… would it be all right if,
we talked a little longer……?

Answering her with a nod,
I pick up the freshman girl…… #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.

Luckily, the Infirmary is right around the corner.
I should get her to a bed first.

I haven't forgotten anything.
There's no reason for me to go back outside.
I should get to class.

The outside has already been covered with pitch-black Noise.
If I don't run #C000246204up#CDEF……!

I should go see #C236196003Rin Tohsaka#CDEF before I go home.
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF said she's probably in the garden.

I'm feeling pretty good.
I don't need to be checked out at the Infirmary.

There's no sign of anyone in the Infirmary.
Looks like the nurse and the health committee are all out.

While I am worried about how #C236196003Sakura#CDEF is doing,
I should let her get some rest.
I #[should probably][think I should]# go home for the day.
The cafeteria is just up ahead.

They've been remodelling it since last week,
so no one's allowed to go in right now.
The cafeteria is just up ahead.

They've been remodelling it since last week,
so none of us could get any lunch.
The students are very dissatisfied.
There's no choice but to go #C000246204up#CDEF……!
The supply room……?

No, Issei said it was the #C000246204supply storeroom#CDEF.
It's not this one, but the storeroom #C000246204to the far left#CDEF.

……if I see this as a classroom,
then I'm probably not thinking straight.

I can't just stand here, zoned out. Let's get a move on
and head to the #C000246204classroom on the 2nd floor#CDEF.

……come to think of it,
I've never seen anyone come and go from this room before.
Is it just not in use right now?

…………!
As soon as I open the supply room,
a pitch-black tentacle reaches out from inside.
I can't let myself get caught by those tendrils……!
This is classroom 1-A.

Even though no one is around,
the silence is so absolute that it's somewhat unnerving.
This is classroom 1-A.

There are still a few students around,
but they'd give a weird look
if some upperclassman just walked in.
I should do them a favor and quietly take my leave.

This classroom's already gone……!
There's nowhere to go but #C000246204up#CDEF!
This is classroom 1-B.

This classroom feels totally lifeless.
Doesn't look like anyone is around.
This is classroom 1-B.

There're several students chatting away.
But there isn't anyone I recognize.
This is classroom 1-C.

All of the first year classrooms seem totally devoid of life.
I wonder what's going on.
This is classroom 1-C.

There's no one in this classroom.
I guess everyone already left for home.

Inside the faculty office, the teachers
are all busy preparing for their classes.
It's the usual scene before the school day begins.

I'd get yelled at if I went into the faculty office now,
so I'm not gonna do that.

There aren't many students who like visiting
the faculty office. And sorry to say,
but #[I'm][I happen to be]# in the majority that don't.

I feel a dull pain the moment I make contact
with the tendril coming from the alarm.
It's too dangerous here. I have to run……!
I think I was taught how to use a fire extinguisher……
I can't seem to remember how though.

I tried going for the fire extinguisher,
but the pitch-black Noise cut me off before I could!
I'll have to give up on it and run!
The exam schedule has been posted.

Exams……
I regret even thinking about this topic.

I reach for the bulletin board, but a dull pain
makes me reflexively draw back.
I have to run away, or else this Noise will……
It's a bulletin board, but nothing's posted here.

There's no time to look at something like that.
I have keep running #C000246204up#CDEF……!
[Fighting on school grounds is strictly prohibited.]
It's a bulletin board, but nothing's posted here.

The schedule for the freshmen's school year
is written up here.

It's pretty much the same as the other grades,
the biggest difference being the entrance ceremony in April.

Below Student Council President #C236196003Issei#CDEF,
the names of the other members are posted.
[From the Faculty:

Next week is exam week.
   Make sure to wrap up club activities early
   and try to be in your best shape for your exams.]

There's no time to look at something like that.
I have keep running #C000246204up#CDEF……!
[Notice from the Health Committee]

Things like nutritional balance, washing your hands,
and rinsing your mouth are written up on here.
The boys' bathroom.
I don't need to go right now.
The boys' bathroom.
……yep, I don't have the guts to walk in.

It's already been covered by the Noise.
I'll have to find another place to run……!
The girls' bathroom.
The girls' bathroom.
I don't need to go right now.

Did you happen to notice the students
wearing different-color uniforms?

Black uniforms are worn by the
public morals committee and club presidents.

I want to improve my autonomic precision,
promote from being an ordinary student―so I
can stand by President #C236196003Ryuudou#CDEF's side too……

Ohhh my gosh……
Did I really just say that?

Not too long ago, he……
Oh, s-sorry, it's nothing!

O-oh no! I didn't say anything!
Please don't mention it!

#C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF…… She's great, isn't she?
Just once, I wanna stroke
that nice black hair of hers……

'kay, when we get back,
we're going to cram school.
Entrance exam prep sure is harsh～

My friend went home without waiting for me,
and she's not answering my messages……

We agreed to meet up here,
then go to cram school together.
Now what do I do……?

I have to get…… to cram school……
I have to go, but……
my body won't move……

What is "cram school," anyway?
I don't care…… there's no point in going……
As soon as…… I fall asleep…… everyth……

Hey hey, didja hear? About the one
in charge of that second year class.

Whaaat? You're kidding! It's already a no-no for
a student and teacher to have a relationship,
but to risk it ON campus!? Now that's brave!

Yeah, yeah. He's a grade above us, but
he's so cute that he doesn't look it at all.
He's so tiny and cute, isn't he～

But something about the youthfulness
he exudes seems out of place……

Good morning, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.
If you loaf around this much,
you'll end up being late.

Good morning, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
If you loaf around this much,
you'll end up being late.

Isn't it such a pain that we have to
climb up to the second floor?

Did you know that the art club
picks out daily themes for their sketches?

Today's theme is "cherry#RUBS     sakura#RUBE#REND blossoms."
But cherry blossoms aren't even in season!
Oh, what should I do……

Nothing to do 'bout it, then.
Guess I'll skip club today as well
and go home. It's lovely weather out.
You can check your #C000246204next goal#CDEF
……I've somehow been run out of the storeroom.

I hear a click-clack from the keys locking the door.
It seems that it's been tightly shut from the inside.

As I leave the dark storeroom, I think to myself how odd it is.
Had there always been participants like that here?

I wonder if I'm still half-asleep……
I feel more restless this morning than I've ever been.

It might be a fever, so I should probably
head home right after school……

Man, what a letdown. I came to check up on you,
but it looks like it wasn't necessary.

I did say that all I can do is place my bets
on you now that we've come this far.

If you kick the bucket, I'm in trouble.
That's why I came to see how you were doing.
Yep, that's it. No other reason.

By the way…
